newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Arno maintained as buy. [CORRECTED 19:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Arno maintained as buy. [CORRECTED 19:55 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to show rating has been maintained as a buy and not that coverage had just been initiated.)
-- Fator Securities said in a report it had maintained its buy rating on Brazilian electrical and electronic goods producer Arno SA.
-- "Low multiples such as FV/EBITDA of 0.9x and P/E of 3.4x for 1997 and cash flow discounted at 25 percent show appreciation potential of 39.8 percent," the bank said.

-- Arno's high dividend pay out of 56 percent of the total profit coupled with its large market share of 50 percent in some sectors make the firm "an attractive target for foreign companies to enter the Brazilian market," it said.
-- Arno preferred stock has jumped 7.25 percent to 207 reais.
